title: Siege of Anzele
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Anzele", at revision 1370738927, opens: "The siege of Anzele was an armed operation between Portugal and the Kingdom of Ndongo, in 1579, and the first military action of the Angolan Wars, which would then continue for over a century." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q138606175, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1579 siege". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
